_comment: The behavioural contract between the two Caster apps.
Caster is written twice - SwiftUI on iOS, Compose on Android - because no
tool shares a UIKit multi-touch layer, Core Haptics and AVAudioEngine with
Android. That is a deliberate choice, but it means these two codebases can
drift silently: a tuning constant changed on one side and not the other
makes the same game feel different on the two phones, and nothing fails.
This file is the fixture both test suites read. Change a value here and both
sides go red until they agree. Do not edit it to make a test pass - edit it
when the behaviour is meant to change, then change both apps.
Android reads it in ParityTest.kt. The iOS side has no test target yet.

seatColors._comment: Theme.swift:33-42 and Theme.kt:66-75. Order is the seat order.

spreadRules._comment: PlayerPalette.spread, for wheels past the fixed eight.

timing._comment: Seconds on iOS, milliseconds on Android. Values here are ms.

draw._comment: Invariants of DrawEngine, not a fixed sequence - the draw is random by design.
